questions.stem:
An agent will usually be liable under a contract made with a third party when the agent is acting on behalf of
A disclosed principal | An undisclosed principal

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
An agency relationship exists when one party (agent) acts on behalf of another (principal) in contractual dealings with a third party. The agent's liability for a contract it makes with a third party differs depending on the information the agent reveals about the principal.

When the principal's identity is fully disclosed, only the principal is liable under any contract the agent makes with a third party.

When the principal is partially disclosed, the third party knows there is a principal but does not know the principal's identity. In this case, both the agent and the principal are liable under any contract the agent makes with a third party.

When the principal is undisclosed, the third party is led to believe the agent is acting on their own behalf. In this case, the agent is liable under any contract it makes with a third party. The principal is not liable but must indemnify the agent for its liability for the contract.

A partial or undisclosed principal is often used when the principal benefits by the third party not knowing the information (wealthy principal buying multiple, plots of land).
questions.explanationJa: 代理人の契約責任は、本人についてどこまで相手方に明かしたかで決まる。本人の身元を完全に明かした場合（顕名の本人）は、本人だけが責任を負い、代理人は責任を負わない。本人の存在を明かさず、代理人が自分のために行動していると相手方に信じさせた場合（非顕名の本人）は、代理人が契約上の責任を負う。なお、本人の存在は明かしたが身元を明かさなかった場合は、本人と代理人の双方が責任を負う。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.1

questions.stem: Which of the following acts, if committed by an agent, will cause a principal to be liable to a third party?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A negligent act committed by an independent contractor, in performance of the contract, which results in injury to a third party.

choices.label: B
choices.text: An intentional tort committed by an employee outside the scope of employment, which results in injury to a third party.

choices.label: C
choices.text: An employee's failure to notify the employer of a dangerous condition that results in injury to a third party.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A negligent act committed by an employee outside the scope of employment that results in injury to a third party.

questions.explanation:
When hiring someone for services, it is important (for liability purposes) to determine whether there is an independent contractor (IC), agency, or employment relationship.

Agency relationship: In an agency relationship, the principal has significant control over the agent. Therefore, the principal is liable for contracts and torts created by the agent acting within the scope of the relationship.

Employment relationship: An employment relationship is a special type of agency relationship that has additional legal obligations and duties (job safety rules, payroll taxes). Like an agency relationship, the employer has significant control over the employee. Based on respondeat superior, the employer is liable for contracts and torts (bodily injury) caused by the employee acting within the scope of employment.

IC relationship: In an IC relationship the IC is not subject to the control of the hiring party. Therefore, the IC (not the hiring party) is liable for all contracts and torts (bodily injury) created while performing the duties of the IC agreement ("A negligent act committed by an independent contractor, in performanc…").

("An intentional tort committed by an employee outside the scope of emp…" / "A negligent act committed by an employee outside the scope of employm…") An employer is not responsible for an employee's intentional or negligent torts when the employee is acting outside the scope of employment.
questions.explanationJa: 雇用関係は代理関係の一種であり、使用者責任（respondeat superior）により、使用者は職務の範囲内で生じた従業員の不法行為について責任を負う。危険な状態を雇用主に知らせなかったという従業員の過失によって第三者が負傷した場合、使用者である本人が責任を負う。独立契約者は委託者の支配下にないので、その過失の責任は独立契約者自身が負う。また、従業員が職務の範囲外で行った故意または過失による不法行為について、使用者は責任を負わない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.2

questions.stem:
Part agreed to act as Young's agent to sell Young's land. Part was instructed to disclose that Part was acting as an agent but not to disclose Young's identity. Part contracted with Rice for Rice to purchase the land. After Rice discovered Young's identity, Young refused to fulfill the contract. Whom does Rice have a cause of action against?
Part | Young

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
An agency relationship exists when one party (the agent) acts on behalf of another (the principal) in contractual obligations with third parties. The principal (Young) will always be liable for the contracts the agent (Part) makes with a third party (Rice) on the principal's behalf. The agent's liability depends on the information the agent reveals about the principal to the third party.

Principal fully disclosed: If Part discloses Young's identity, then Young is the only one liable on the contract Part makes with Rice. Rice has a cause of action against Young, but not Part.

Principal partially disclosed: In this situation, Part told Rice only that Part was an agent for a principal but did not disclose Young's identity. When the principal is partially disclosed, both the agent and the principal are liable under any contract the agent makes with a third party. Therefore, Rice has a cause of action against Young and Part.

Principal undisclosed: If Part leads Rice to believe that Part is acting alone (no principal involved), then Part is liable on the contract. Young is not liable on the contract but must indemnify Part for Part's liability on it.

The agent is held liable in the partial and undisclosed situations because the third party enters the contract based on the agent's trustworthiness and reputation.
questions.explanationJa: 代理人が本人のために結んだ契約について、本人は常に責任を負う。代理人の責任は、本人について相手方に何を明かしたかで決まる。Partは代理人であることを明かしたがYoungの身元は明かしていないので、本人の部分的開示に当たり、本人と代理人の双方が責任を負う。相手方は代理人の信用を頼りに契約したと考えられるからである。よってRiceはPartとYoungの両方に請求できる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.4

questions.stem:
Which of the following statements represent(s) a principal's duty to an agent who works on a commission basis?
I. The principal is required to maintain pertinent records,account to the agent, and pay the agent according to the terms of their agreement .
II. The principal is required to reimburse the agent for all authorized expenses incurred unless the agreement calls for the agent to pay expenses out of the commission .
I | II

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
When a principal pays an agent a commission, it implies that the principal will maintain proper records of the commission calculation. In addition, if the agent requests support or evidence of the calculation, the principal is obligated to show the agent the commission records (an accounting).

A principal is obligated to reimburse an agent for all authorized expenses incurred while performing duties for the principal. However, the parties can agree that the agent must pay its own expenses out of the earned commissions instead of being reimbursed separately.
questions.explanationJa: 歩合制で報酬を支払う場合、本人は歩合の計算記録を適切に保存し、代理人から求められれば記録を示して計算を説明し（会計報告）、合意どおりに支払う義務を負う。また、本人は、代理人が職務遂行中に支出した承認済みの費用を償還する義務を負う。ただし、代理人が歩合から自分で経費を負担すると合意した場合は、別途の償還はない。よって、どちらの記述も本人の義務に当たる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.5

questions.stem: When an agent acts for an undisclosed principal, the principal will not be liable to third parties if the

choices.label: A
choices.text: Principal ratifies a contract entered into by the agent.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Agent acts within an implied grant of authority.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Agent acts outside the grant of actual authority.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Principal seeks to conceal the agency relationship.

questions.explanation:
In an agency relationship, when an agent acts outside the authority granted by an undisclosed principal, the principal is not liable for the contract. The undisclosed principal will be liable for the contract only if it chooses to ratify the contract

("Principal ratifies a contract entered into by the agent."). Ratification occurs when the principal either:

explicitly accepts the unauthorized contract or

remains silent and accepts the benefits of the contract.

("Agent acts within an implied grant of authority.") Implied/apparent authority occurs when the principal takes an action that leads a third party to believe the agent has authority to enter contracts on the principal's behalf. Therefore, an agent can act within an implied/apparent grant of authority only if the principal is disclosed to the third party.

("Principal seeks to conceal the agency relationship.") Being undisclosed (concealed) does not alone make the principal liable for a contract the agent makes. An undisclosed principal is often used when the principal benefits from the third party not knowing the information (wealthy principal buying multiple plots of land).
questions.explanationJa: 非顕名の本人は、代理人が実際に与えた権限の範囲を越えて結んだ契約については責任を負わない。ただし、本人が契約を明示的に受け入れるか、黙って契約の利益を受け取ることで追認した場合は、責任を負う。表見代理は、本人の行動によって相手方が代理権を信じた場合に成立するものであり、本人が相手方に知られていない非顕名の場合には成立しない。本人が代理関係を隠していることだけでは、本人に責任は生じない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.6

questions.stem: Orr gives North power of attorney. In general, the power of attorney

choices.label: A
choices.text: Will be valid only if North is a licensed attorney at law.

choices.label: B
choices.text: May continue in existence after Orr's death.

choices.label: C
choices.text: May limit North's authority to specific transactions.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Must be signed by both Orr and North.

questions.explanation:
Elements of a power of attorney (POA)

Express grant of actual authority to an agent

In writing

Signed by principal

Usually notarized

Two types:

General (agent can do anything principal can do)

Limited (agent has only specific powers listed in the POA)

May or may not terminate on incapacity of principal

Always terminates on death of principal

A common form of agency is a power of attorney (POA), which is a written authorization for the agent (North) to act on behalf of the principal (Orr) for a specific or indefinite period of time. A POA may be limited, granting the agent authority to act in only certain matters, or general, granting the agent authority to act in all matters.

POAs created in anticipation of the principal's mental state deteriorating often include a specific provision keeping the POA enforceable in the event of the principal's insanity or incapacity. The POA always terminates upon the death of the principal ("May continue in existence after Orr's death."). Post-death matters (probating the will) are handled through administration of the decedent's estate.

("Will be valid only if North is a licensed attorney at law.") Anyone with legal capacity can be an agent in a POA. There are no licensing requirements (licensed attorney).

("Must be signed by both Orr and North.") A POA must be signed by the person granting it (Orr), and most states also require it to be signed and notarized by a notary public. However, the agent is not required to sign the POA.
questions.explanationJa: 委任状（power of attorney）は、本人（Orr）が代理人（North）に実際の権限を明示的に与える書面で、本人が署名し、通常は公証を受ける。委任状には、本人ができることを何でも代理できる包括的なものと、特定の事項に権限を限る限定的なものがあるので、Northの権限を特定の取引に限ることができる。代理人は弁護士である必要はなく、法的能力があれば誰でもなれ、代理人の署名も不要である。本人の無能力に備えて存続させる定めは置けるが、本人の死亡時には必ず終了する。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Agency Q.7

questions.stem: Under agency law, which of the following statements best describes ratification?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A principal's affirmation of an agent's authorized act

choices.label: B
choices.text: A principal's affirmation of an agent's unauthorized act

choices.label: C
choices.text: A principal's approval in advance of an agent's acts

choices.label: D
choices.text: A principal's disavowal of an agent's unauthorized act

questions.explanation:
Ratification is the principal's affirmation, after the fact, of an act that was done on the principal's behalf without authority (Restatement (Third) of Agency §4.01). Once the principal ratifies with knowledge of the material facts, the unauthorized act is treated as if it had been authorized from the outset, and the principal is bound to the third party.

An agent's authorized act needs no ratification because the principal is already bound by it.
Approval given in advance is a grant of actual (express) authority, not ratification, which always occurs after the act.
A disavowal of the unauthorized act is the opposite of ratification; it is a repudiation that leaves the principal unbound (absent apparent authority).
questions.explanationJa:
追認（ratification）とは、権限なく本人のためにされた行為を、本人が事後に承認することをいう。重要な事実を知ったうえで追認すると、その行為は最初から権限があったものとして扱われ、本人は相手方に拘束される。
権限内の行為は最初から本人を拘束するので追認は不要。事前の承認は実際の権限（明示の授権）の付与であって追認ではない。無権限行為を否認することは追認の反対で、本人は（表見代理が成立しない限り）拘束されない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2011 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. 9844)

questions.stem: Which of the following conditions must be met to form an agency?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An agency agreement must be in writing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: An agency agreement must be signed by both parties.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The principal must furnish legally adequate consideration for the agent’s services.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The principal must possess contractual capacity.

questions.explanation:
An agency is a consensual relationship in which the principal manifests assent that the agent will act on the principal's behalf and subject to the principal's control, and the agent consents. Because the agent's acts bind the principal, the principal must have contractual capacity; an agent's contracts are only as valid as if the principal had made them personally.

An agency agreement generally does not have to be in writing (the equal dignity rule is a narrow exception for agents who will sign contracts that must themselves be written). It need not be signed by both parties. Consideration is not required either; a gratuitous agency is valid, so the principal does not have to furnish legally adequate consideration.
questions.explanationJa:
代理は、本人が代理人に自己のために自己の支配の下で行動させる意思を表示し、代理人が同意することで成立する合意関係である。代理人の行為は本人を拘束するため、本人が契約能力を有していることが必要となる。

代理契約は原則として書面を要しない（書面を要する契約を締結する代理人に対する同等形式の原則は限定的な例外）。両当事者の署名も不要。約因も不要で、無償の代理も有効なので、本人が代理人に法的に十分な対価を与える必要はない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.5 (AICPA No. 90205)

questions.stem: After which of the following situations would it usually not be necessary to notify third parties of the termination of an agency's existence?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The achieving of the agency’s purpose

choices.label: B
choices.text: The destruction of the subject matter of the agency

choices.label: C
choices.text: A termination by mutual agreement

choices.label: D
choices.text: A termination by the principal

questions.explanation:
When an agency terminates by operation of law (for example, death or incapacity of the principal or agent, bankruptcy, impossibility, or destruction of the subject matter of the agency), both actual and apparent authority end automatically, and no notice to third parties is required.

When an agency ends by act of the parties, such as the achievement of the agency's purpose, a termination by mutual agreement, or a termination by the principal, apparent authority may continue as to third parties who knew of the agency. The principal must therefore give actual notice to third parties who dealt with the agent and constructive notice (for example, publication) to others who knew of the agency.
questions.explanationJa:
代理が法の作用によって終了する場合（本人・代理人の死亡・無能力、破産、履行不能、代理の目的物の滅失など）、実際の権限も表見代理権も自動的に消滅し、第三者への通知は不要である。

目的の達成、合意解約、本人による解任など当事者の行為による終了では、代理の存在を知る第三者に対して表見代理権が残りうる。そのため本人は、代理人と取引した第三者には実際の通知を、代理の存在を知るその他の者には公告などの擬制通知をする必要がある。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2014 Recently Released Q.23 (AICPA No. 90573)

questions.stem: Green entered into an oral agency agreement to purchase real estate on behalf of Smith. Subsequently, Green entered into a written contract to buy land from Davis without disclosing the relationship with Smith. Which of the following is Smith's best legal defense if Smith does not want the land?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Green failed to disclose Smith's relationship as principal.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Green failed to get the agency agreement in writing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Green’s act was a misrepresentation of Green’s express authority.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Green failed to get Smith's consent before entering into the contract with Davis.

questions.explanation:
Under the equal dignity rule, when the contract the agent is to enter into must be in writing under the statute of frauds (such as a contract for the sale of an interest in land), the agent's authority to enter into that contract must also be in writing. Green's authority to buy real estate was given orally, so Smith's best defense is that the agency agreement was not in writing and Green lacked enforceable authority to bind Smith to the land contract.

Failure to disclose the principal does not prevent an undisclosed principal from being bound; an undisclosed principal is liable on a contract the agent was authorized to make. Green did not misrepresent express authority, because Green was in fact appointed to purchase real estate. Smith had already authorized the purchase, so no additional consent was required for the particular contract.
questions.explanationJa:
同等形式の原則（equal dignity rule）により、代理人が締結する契約が詐欺防止法上書面を要する場合（土地の権利の売買など）、その契約を締結する代理権の授与も書面でなければならない。Greenへの不動産購入の代理権は口頭で与えられたので、Smithの最善の抗弁は代理契約が書面でなかったことである。

本人を開示しなかったことは抗弁にならず、代理人に権限があれば隠れた本人も契約に拘束される。Greenは実際に不動産の購入を任されていたので、明示の権限を偽ったことにはならない。Smithは購入自体を既に授権しており、個別の契約ごとに追加の同意は要らない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2016 Recently Released Q.2 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Baker sold an automobile to Bob's Old Autos, where Fuller is a manager. Fuller took $100 from Baker for encouraging the sale. What duty to Bob's Old Autos did Fuller violate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Reasonable care.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Reimbursement.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Obedience.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Loyalty.

questions.explanation:
An agent owes the principal a fiduciary duty of loyalty, which includes the duty not to acquire a material benefit from a third party in connection with actions taken on the principal's behalf (Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.02). By taking $100 from Baker for encouraging the purchase, Fuller (a manager acting for Bob's Old Autos) received a secret payment from the other side of the transaction and violated the duty of loyalty.

The duty of reasonable care concerns performing tasks with the competence and diligence normally exercised by agents. Reimbursement is a duty the principal owes the agent, not a duty of the agent. The duty of obedience requires following the principal's lawful instructions; nothing indicates that Fuller disobeyed an instruction.
questions.explanationJa:
代理人は本人に対して忠実義務（duty of loyalty）を負い、本人のために行う行為に関して第三者から重要な利益を受け取らない義務もこれに含まれる（Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.02）。Bob's Old Autosのために行動する管理者Fullerが、取引の相手方であるBakerから売却を後押しする見返りに$100を受け取ったことは、忠実義務違反である。

合理的注意義務は通常の代理人が用いる能力と注意で職務を行う義務である。費用償還（reimbursement）は本人が代理人に負う義務で、代理人の義務ではない。服従義務は本人の適法な指示に従う義務で、Fullerが指示に背いた事実は無い。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2016 Recently Released Q.25 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Which of the following duties is owed by a principal to an agent?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Accountability.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Performance.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Ratification.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Indemnification.

questions.explanation:
A principal owes the agent duties of compensation, reimbursement, indemnification, and cooperation. Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.14, the principal must indemnify the agent for payments made and losses incurred while acting within the scope of actual authority.

Accountability (the duty to account for money and property) and performance (the duty to perform with reasonable care and skill) are duties the agent owes to the principal. Ratification is not a duty at all; it is the principal's optional affirmation of an act done without authority.
questions.explanationJa:
本人が代理人に負う義務は、報酬支払、費用償還、補償（indemnification）、協力である。Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.14により、本人は代理人が実際の権限内で行為する際に支出した金額や被った損失を補償しなければならない。

会計報告義務（accountability）と職務遂行義務（performance）は代理人が本人に負う義務である。追認（ratification）は義務ではなく、無権限の行為を本人が任意に承認することである。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2017 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Smith entered an oral agreement hiring and authorizing Jones to sell fraudulent identification cards produced by Smith. Smith and Jones orally agreed to share the proceeds from their enterprise. Later, Jones claimed that no enforceable agency relationship was created. Jones is correct because

choices.label: A
choices.text: Jones did not have authority.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Jones did not have contractual capacity.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The purpose of the agency was contrary to public policy.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The agreement was a partnership.

questions.explanation:
An agency relationship created by agreement must have a legal purpose. An agreement to act as an agent to sell fraudulent identification cards has an illegal purpose that is contrary to public policy, so it is void and unenforceable, and no enforceable agency relationship arises.

Jones did have actual authority, because Smith expressly hired and authorized Jones to sell the cards; the problem is the illegality of what was authorized. Nothing in the facts suggests that Jones lacked contractual capacity, and an agent need not even have full capacity to bind a principal. Whether the arrangement to share proceeds might be characterized as a partnership does not make the agency unenforceable; the illegal purpose is what defeats enforcement.
questions.explanationJa:
合意によって成立する代理関係は、適法な目的を持たなければならない。偽造身分証を販売するための代理の合意は違法で公序に反する目的を持つため無効であり、強制可能な代理関係は成立しない。

SmithはJonesを雇って明示的に販売を授権しているので、Jonesに権限がなかったわけではない。問題は授権された行為の違法性である。Jonesに契約能力がなかったことを示す事実はなく、そもそも代理人は完全な行為能力がなくても本人を拘束しうる。収益を分け合う取決めがパートナーシップに当たるかどうかで代理が無効になるわけではなく、強制できない理由は違法な目的にある。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2017 Recently Released Q.24 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Able authorized Brown to enter contracts with third parties on Able's behalf. In which of the following situations must Able provide notice to these third parties to effectively terminate Brown's authority?

choices.label: A
choices.text: When it has become impossible for Brown to lawfully perform Brown's duties.

choices.label: B
choices.text: When war has broken out between Able's country and Brown's country.

choices.label: C
choices.text: When Brown has been declared insane by a court of law.

choices.label: D
choices.text: When Able has revoked Brown's authority.

questions.explanation:
When an agent's actual authority is terminated by an act of the parties, such as the principal's revocation, apparent authority can continue as to third parties who reasonably believe the agent is still authorized (Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.11). The principal must therefore give notice to third parties (actual notice to those who dealt with the agent and constructive notice to others) to cut off apparent authority after revoking Brown's authority.

Termination by operation of law, such as impossibility of performance, the outbreak of war between the principal's and agent's countries, or the agent's adjudicated insanity, ends the authority without the need for notice to third parties.
questions.explanationJa:
本人による授権の撤回のように当事者の行為で代理権が終了した場合、代理人がまだ権限を持つと合理的に信じる第三者に対しては表見代理権が存続しうる（Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.11）。そのため本人は、Brownの権限を撤回した後、表見代理権を断つために第三者へ通知する必要がある（取引のあった者には個別通知、その他の者には公告などの擬制通知）。

履行の不能、本人と代理人の国の間の戦争の勃発、代理人が裁判所で心神喪失と宣告されたことは法の作用による終了であり、第三者への通知なしに代理権が終了する。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2018 Recently Released Q.3 (AICPA No. 60649)

questions.stem: Ace Corporation engaged Kosier, CPA, to perform a consulting engagement. While driving to Ace's office, Kosier was involved in an automobile accident in which Norton was injured. The accident was solely Kosier's fault. If Norton sues both Ace and Kosier for the injuries Norton sustained, what will be the result?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both Kosier and Ace will be liable.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Kosier will be liable, and Ace will not be liable because Kosier is an independent contractor.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Ace will be liable under the principle of respondeat superior, and Kosier will not be liable.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ace will be liable because of Kosier’s actual authority, and Kosier will not be liable.

questions.explanation:
Under respondeat superior, an employer is vicariously liable for torts an employee commits within the scope of employment (Restatement (Third) of Agency §7.07). A person who engages an independent contractor generally is not liable for the contractor's physical torts, because the hiring party does not control the manner and means of the work (Restatement (Second) of Agency §220). Kosier, a CPA engaged to perform a consulting engagement, is an independent contractor of Ace, and Ace did not control how Kosier drove to its office. Kosier, who was solely at fault, is personally liable to Norton, and Ace is not.

Kosier is not relieved of liability for Kosier's own negligence in any situation; a tortfeasor is always liable for the tortfeasor's own conduct. Respondeat superior does not reach Ace because Kosier is not Ace's employee, and actual authority to perform consulting work does not make Ace liable for Kosier's negligent driving.
questions.explanationJa:
使用者責任（respondeat superior）により、雇用主は被用者が職務の範囲内で行った不法行為について代位責任を負う（Restatement (Third) of Agency §7.07）。一方、独立請負人を使う者は作業の方法・手段を支配しないため、原則として請負人の不法行為の責任を負わない（Restatement (Second) of Agency §220）。コンサルティング業務を受託したCPAのKosierはAceの独立請負人であり、Aceは事務所への運転方法を支配していない。事故の全責任があるKosierはNortonに対して責任を負い、Aceは責任を負わない。

自らの過失による不法行為の責任を加害者が免れることはないので、Kosierが責任を負わないとする記述はいずれも誤り。KosierはAceの被用者ではないので使用者責任はAceに及ばず、コンサルティングを行う実際の権限があってもKosierの過失運転についてAceが責任を負うことにはならない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2018 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. 60521)

questions.stem: What contractual duty does a principal owe to a gratuitous agent?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Duty of diligence.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Duty to compensate.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Duty to indemnify.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Duty of obedience.

questions.explanation:
A principal owes an agent a duty to indemnify (reimburse) the agent for payments and losses the agent incurs while acting within the scope of the agency (Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.14). This duty exists even when the agent serves without pay (a gratuitous agent).

The duty to compensate does not arise because a gratuitous agent has agreed to act without pay. The duty of diligence and the duty of obedience are duties the agent owes to the principal, not duties the principal owes to the agent.
questions.explanationJa:
本人（principal）は代理人に対し、代理の範囲内で代理人が負担した支出や損失を補償（償還）する義務を負う（Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.14）。この義務は無報酬の代理人（gratuitous agent）に対しても存在する。

無報酬の代理人は報酬なしで行動することに合意しているので、報酬支払義務は生じない。注意義務（diligence）と服従義務（obedience）は代理人が本人に負う義務であり、本人が代理人に負う義務ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2019 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. 58379)

questions.stem: Which of the following independent contractors is considered an agent?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A taxicab driver hired to carry a passenger to the airport.

choices.label: B
choices.text: An attorney retained to handle the sale of a family home.

choices.label: C
choices.text: An artist commissioned to paint a person’s portrait.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A mason hired to build a stone fence around a property.

questions.explanation:
Agency is a fiduciary relationship in which the principal manifests assent that the agent shall act on the principal's behalf and subject to the principal's control, and the agent consents (Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.01). An attorney retained to handle the sale of a family home acts on the client's behalf in dealing with third parties, such as negotiating and executing documents, and is therefore an agent as well as an independent contractor.

A taxicab driver carrying a passenger to the airport, an artist painting a portrait, and a mason building a stone fence each perform a service for the hiring party but do not act on that party's behalf in dealings with third parties, so they are independent contractors who are not agents.
questions.explanationJa:
代理とは、本人が「代理人が本人のために、本人の支配に服して行動する」ことに同意を示し、代理人もこれに同意する信認関係をいう（Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.01）。自宅の売却手続きを任された弁護士は、交渉や書類の締結など第三者との取引を依頼者のために行うので、独立請負人であると同時に代理人でもある。

空港まで乗客を運ぶタクシー運転手、肖像画を描く画家、石塀を造る石工は、依頼者のために役務を提供するだけで、第三者との取引で依頼者に代わって行動するわけではないため、代理人ではない独立請負人である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2019 Recently Released Q.25 (AICPA No. 59863)

questions.stem: Clarett, who owned a retail business, left a note on a desk Clarett thought was occupied by Franklen. The note stated, "Please contract to purchase 20,000 widgets at the best possible price from Eisen Corp. for delivery in March." The desk was actually being used by Saranz, who made a contract for the purchase of the widgets as specified. Saranz had little negotiating experience and contracted for a high price. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the authority held by Saranz?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Saranz had apparent, but not actual, authority to make the contract, so the contract is not enforceable by Eisen.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Saranz did not have any authority to make the contract, so the contract is not enforceable by Eisen.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Saranz had actual authority to make the contract, so the contract is enforceable by Eisen.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Saranz had authority by ratification, so the contract is enforceable by Eisen.

questions.explanation:
Actual authority is created by the principal's manifestation to the agent that, as reasonably understood by the agent, expresses the principal's assent that the agent act on the principal's behalf (Restatement (Third) of Agency §§2.01, 3.01). Clarett left a written instruction on the desk Clarett believed was occupied by a person who would act for Clarett, and Saranz, who used that desk, reasonably understood the note as an instruction to make the contract. Saranz contracted exactly as specified (20,000 widgets from Eisen Corp. for March delivery), so Saranz acted with actual authority and the contract binds Clarett and is enforceable by Eisen. Saranz's lack of negotiating skill and the high price do not take the contract outside the authority given, because the note set no price limit.

Apparent authority arises from the principal's manifestation to the third party, and Clarett made no manifestation to Eisen; in any event, the contract is enforceable. The position that Saranz had no authority at all ignores Clarett's written manifestation. Ratification applies only when an agent acts without authority and the principal later affirms the act; no later affirmation is described, and none is needed because Saranz already had actual authority.
questions.explanationJa:
実際の権限（actual authority）は、本人が代理人に対して示した意思表示を代理人が合理的に理解し、本人のために行動することへの本人の同意と受け取ったときに生じる（代理法第3リステイトメント §2.01, §3.01）。Clarettは自分のために動く者の机だと考えた机に書面の指示を置き、その机を使っていたSaranzはそれを契約締結の指示と合理的に理解した。Saranzは指示どおり（Eisen社から20,000個のウィジェットを3月納品で購入）契約しており、実際の権限に基づく行為としてClarettを拘束し、Eisenは契約を強制できる。メモに価格の上限がない以上、交渉が下手で高値になったことは権限の範囲外とする理由にならない。

表見代理（apparent authority）は本人から第三者への表示によって生じるが、ClarettはEisenに何も表示していない。権限が全くなかったとする見解は、Clarettの書面による意思表示を無視している。追認は無権限の行為を本人が後から承認する場合の法理であり、本問に追認の事実はなく、実際の権限がある以上その必要もない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2020 Recently Released Part2 Q.25 (AICPA No. 61417)

questions.stem: Which of the following events will always terminate an agent's apparent authority?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The principal's death.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The principal revoking the relationship.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The agent's renunciation of the relationship.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both the principal and agent agree to terminate the relationship.

questions.explanation:
An agency relationship terminates by operation of law upon the death of the principal, and under the traditional rule (Restatement (Second) of Agency §120) the death terminates the agent's power to bind the principal, including apparent authority, automatically and without notice to the agent or to third parties. The principal's death therefore always terminates apparent authority.

When the agency is ended by an act of the parties, such as the principal's revocation, the agent's renunciation, or a mutual agreement to terminate, the agent's actual authority ends, but apparent authority continues as to third parties who dealt with the agent until they receive notice of the termination (Restatement (Second) of Agency §§124A, 125). These events therefore do not always terminate apparent authority.
questions.explanationJa:
本人の死亡によって代理関係は法律上当然に終了し、伝統的なルール（代理法第2リステイトメント §120）では、代理人や第三者への通知がなくても、表見代理を含めて本人を拘束する代理人の権能が自動的に消滅する。したがって本人の死亡は常に表見代理を終了させる。

本人の解任、代理人の辞任、双方の合意による終了のように当事者の行為で代理関係が終わる場合、実際の権限は消滅するが、代理人と取引してきた第三者に対しては、終了の通知を受けるまで表見代理が存続する（同 §124A, §125）。したがってこれらは常に表見代理を終了させるわけではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2021 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. 64691)

questions.stem: A principal and agent relationship requires a

choices.label: A
choices.text: Written agreement

choices.label: B
choices.text: Power of attorney

choices.label: C
choices.text: Meeting of the minds and consent to act

choices.label: D
choices.text: Specified consideration

questions.explanation:
Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.01, agency is the fiduciary relationship that arises when a principal manifests assent to an agent that the agent shall act on the principal's behalf and subject to the principal's control, and the agent manifests assent or otherwise consents so to act. The relationship therefore rests on mutual consent, a meeting of the minds between principal and agent.

A written agreement is generally not required; an agency may be created orally or by conduct, with writings needed only in special cases such as under an equal dignity rule. A power of attorney is just one written form of appointing an agent and is not required for every agency. Consideration is not required either, because a gratuitous agent is still an agent (Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.04 comment).
questions.explanationJa:
Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.01 によれば、代理は、本人が代理人に対して自分のために自分の指揮のもとで行動することへの同意を表示し、代理人もそのように行動することに同意したときに成立する信認関係です。したがって代理関係の基礎は双方の合意（meeting of the minds）です。

代理は口頭や行動でも成立し、書面は equal dignity rule のような特別な場合にしか必要ありません。委任状（power of attorney）は代理人を選任する書面の一形式にすぎず、すべての代理に必要なわけではありません。また無償の代理人も代理人なので、対価（consideration）も要件ではありません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.16

questions.stem: Blue, a used car dealer, appointed Gage as an agent to sell Blue's cars. Gage was authorized by Blue to appoint subagents to assist in the sale of the cars. Vond was appointed as a subagent. To whom does Vond owe a fiduciary duty?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Gage only

choices.label: B
choices.text: Blue only

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both Blue and Gage

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither Blue nor Gage

questions.explanation:
Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.15, a subagent is a person appointed by an agent, with actual authority to do so, to perform functions the agent has consented to perform on behalf of the principal. The subagent acts as an agent of both the appointing agent and the principal, so the subagent owes fiduciary duties to both. Blue authorized Gage to appoint subagents, so Vond is a properly appointed subagent and owes fiduciary duties to both Blue and Gage.

Vond's duty does not run to Gage only, because the subagent ultimately acts on the principal's behalf. It does not run to Blue only, because the appointing agent remains Vond's principal as well. Saying Vond owes no fiduciary duty to either ignores that a subagent is itself an agent.
questions.explanationJa:
Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.15 によれば、復代理人（subagent）は、権限を持つ代理人が本人のための職務を行わせるために選任した者で、選任した代理人と本人の両方の代理人として行動します。そのため両者に対して信認義務（fiduciary duty）を負います。Blue は Gage に復代理人の選任権限を与えているので、Vond は適法に選任された復代理人であり、Blue と Gage の両方に信認義務を負います。

復代理人は最終的に本人のために行動するので、Gage だけに義務を負うのではありません。選任した代理人も Vond の本人に当たるので、Blue だけでもありません。復代理人も代理人である以上、どちらにも義務を負わないということもありません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.18

questions.stem: North, Inc. hired Sutter as a purchasing agent. North gave Sutter written authorization to purchase, without limit, electronic appliances. Later, Sutter was told not to purchase more than 300 of each appliance. Sutter contracted with Orr Corp. to purchase 500 tape recorders. Orr had been shown Sutter's written authorization. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Sutter will be liable to Orr because Sutter's actual authority was exceeded.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sutter will not be liable to reimburse North if North is liable to Orr.

choices.label: C
choices.text: North will be liable to Orr because of Sutter's actual and apparent authority.

choices.label: D
choices.text: North will not be liable to Orr because Sutter's actual authority was exceeded.

questions.explanation:
North is bound to Orr. Sutter had actual authority to buy electronic appliances such as tape recorders for North, and the later private instruction limited only the quantity. Orr had been shown the written authorization to purchase without limit, so Orr reasonably believed, based on North's own manifestation, that Sutter could buy 500 units. Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §2.03 and §6.01, a principal is bound by an agent's contract made with apparent authority, and a secret limitation on actual authority does not affect a third party who did not know of it. North is therefore liable to Orr on the contract.

Sutter is not liable to Orr, because Sutter contracted for a disclosed principal with apparent authority, and the agent of a disclosed principal is not a party to the contract (§6.01). Sutter must reimburse North for any loss, because an agent who exceeds actual authority breaches the duty to act within actual authority and is liable to the principal (§8.09). North cannot escape liability merely because the actual authority was exceeded, because the apparent authority created by the written authorization binds North.
questions.explanationJa:
North は Orr に対して契約上の責任を負います。Sutter にはテープレコーダーを含む電子機器を North のために購入する実際の権限があり、後の内部的な指示は数量を制限しただけでした。Orr は「数量無制限で購入できる」という書面の権限を見せられており、North 自身の表示に基づいて Sutter が500台買えると合理的に信じました。Restatement (Third) of Agency §2.03・§6.01 により、本人は表見代理（apparent authority）による代理人の契約に拘束され、第三者が知らない内部的な制限は第三者に影響しません。

本人が明らかにされた代理（disclosed principal）では代理人は契約当事者にならないため、Sutter が Orr に責任を負うことはありません（§6.01）。一方、実際の権限を超えた代理人は本人に対する義務違反となり（§8.09）、Sutter は North の損失を補償しなければなりません。実際の権限を超えたことだけを理由に North が責任を免れることもできず、書面による表見代理が North を拘束します。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.19

questions.stem:
Trent was retained, in writing, to act as Post's agent for the sale of Post's memorabilia collection. Which of the following statements is correct?
I. To be an agent, Trent must be at least 21 years of age.
II. Post would be liable to Trent if the collection was destroyed before Trent found a purchaser.

choices.label: A
choices.text: I only

choices.label: B
choices.text: II only

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both I and II

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither I nor II

questions.explanation:
Neither statement is correct. Statement I is wrong because there is no minimum age to serve as an agent. An agent's capacity matters only for the agent's own liability; a minor can act as an agent and bind the principal (Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.05).

Statement II is wrong because destruction of the subject matter of the agency terminates the agent's actual authority by operation of law, since the purpose of the agency can no longer be accomplished (Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.09). When the collection is destroyed before Trent finds a purchaser, the agency ends without a breach by Post, so Post is not liable to Trent for the lost sale.
questions.explanationJa:
どちらの記述も誤りです。I について、代理人になるための年齢の要件はありません。代理人の行為能力は代理人自身の責任に関わるだけで、未成年者も代理人として本人を拘束する行為ができます（Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.05）。

II について、代理の対象物が滅失すると、代理の目的が達成できなくなるので、法の作用（operation of law）により代理人の実際の権限は消滅します（Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.09）。Trent が買主を見つける前にコレクションが滅失した場合、Post の義務違反なしに代理関係が終了するので、Post は Trent に責任を負いません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.20

questions.stem: Which of the following rights will a third party be entitled to after validly contracting with an agent representing an undisclosed principal?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Disclosure of the principal by the agent

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ratification of the contract by the principal

choices.label: C
choices.text: Performance of the contract by the agent

choices.label: D
choices.text: Election to void the contract after disclosure of the principal

questions.explanation:
When an agent contracts on behalf of an undisclosed principal, the agent is a party to the contract and is personally liable on it (Restatement (Third) of Agency §6.03). The third party therefore is entitled to performance of the contract by the agent. The undisclosed principal is also bound if the agent acted with actual authority (§6.03).

The third party has no right to demand that the agent disclose the principal; the agent may keep the principal's identity confidential. Ratification is irrelevant because a valid contract made with actual authority needs no ratification, and the third party cannot require it. Discovering the principal's identity does not give the third party a right to void the contract; the third party remains bound, subject only to narrow exceptions such as fraud or a contract term excluding undisclosed principals (§6.11).
questions.explanationJa:
本人を明かさない代理（undisclosed principal）で代理人が契約すると、代理人自身が契約当事者となり、個人として責任を負います（Restatement (Third) of Agency §6.03）。そのため第三者は代理人に契約の履行を求める権利を持ちます。代理人が実際の権限の範囲内で行動していれば、隠れた本人も契約に拘束されます。

第三者が代理人に本人を明かすよう求める権利はありません。実際の権限に基づく有効な契約は追認（ratification）を必要とせず、第三者が追認を求めることもできません。本人の正体が判明しても第三者が契約を無効にできるわけではなく、詐欺や隠れた本人を排除する契約条項などの限られた場合を除き、第三者は契約に拘束されます（§6.11）。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.23

questions.stem:
When a valid contract is entered into by an agent on the principal's behalf, in a nondisclosed principal situation, which of the following statements concerning the principal's liability is correct?

Principal may be held liable once disclosed | Principal must ratify to be held liable

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §6.03, when an agent acting with actual authority makes a contract on behalf of an undisclosed principal, the principal is a party to the contract unless excluded by the contract, and both the principal and the agent are liable to the third party. Once the principal's identity is disclosed, the third party may hold the principal liable.

Ratification is not needed for the principal to be liable. Ratification under Restatement (Third) of Agency §4.01 is a way to bind a principal to an act that was not authorized. Because the question describes a valid contract made on the principal's behalf, the principal is bound by the agent's actual authority without ratifying it.
questions.explanationJa:
Restatement (Third) of Agency §6.03 により、実際の権限を持つ代理人が隠れた本人（undisclosed principal）のために契約した場合、契約で排除されていない限り本人も契約当事者となり、本人と代理人の両方が第三者に責任を負います。本人の正体が判明すれば、第三者は本人に責任を追及できます。

本人が責任を負うために追認は不要です。追認（§4.01）は権限の無い行為に本人を拘束させる手段です。本問は本人のために有効に締結された契約なので、本人は代理人の実際の権限によってすでに拘束されており、追認しなくても責任を負います。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.24

questions.stem:
Which of the following is(are) available to a principal when an agent fraudulently breaches a fiduciary duty?

Termination of the agency | Constructive trust

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
Both remedies are available. A principal always has the power to terminate an agent's actual authority by revoking it (Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.10), and an agent's fraudulent breach of fiduciary duty gives the principal good cause to do so without liability for breach of the agency contract.

The principal may also impose a constructive trust on property or profits the agent obtained through the breach. An agent who acquires a material benefit or diverts property in breach of the duty of loyalty must account to the principal for it (Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.02, §8.05), and a court may declare the agent a constructive trustee whose duty is to transfer that property to the principal. Answers that deny either termination or a constructive trust are therefore incorrect.
questions.explanationJa:
どちらも利用できます。本人はいつでも代理人の実際の権限を撤回して代理関係を終了させる権能を持ち（Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.10）、代理人の詐欺的な信認義務違反があれば、代理契約違反の責任を負わずに終了させる正当な理由になります。

また本人は、代理人が義務違反によって得た財産や利益について、擬制信託（constructive trust）を求めることができます。忠実義務に違反して利益を得たり財産を流用したりした代理人は本人に引き渡す義務を負い（§8.02、§8.05）、裁判所は代理人をその財産を本人に移転する義務を負う擬制受託者とすることができます。どちらか一方でも利用できないとする組み合わせは誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.25

questions.stem: Bolt Corp. dismissed Ace as its general sales agent and notified all of Ace's known customers by letter. Young Corp., a retail outlet located outside of Ace's previously assigned sales territory, had never dealt with Ace. Young knew of Ace as a result of various business contacts. After his dismissal, Ace sold Young goods, to be delivered by Bolt, and received from Young a cash deposit for 20% of the purchase price. It was not unusual for an agent in Ace's previous position to receive cash deposits. In an action by Young against Bolt on the sales contract, Young will

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lose, because Ace lacked any implied authority to make the contract

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lose, because Ace lacked any express authority to make the contract

choices.label: C
choices.text: Win, because Bolt's notice was inadequate to terminate Ace's apparent authority

choices.label: D
choices.text: Win, because a principal is an insurer of an agent's acts

questions.explanation:
When an agency is terminated, the agent's actual authority ends, but apparent authority continues as to third parties who reasonably believe the agent still has authority, until they have notice of the termination (Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.11). Bolt notified only Ace's known customers. Young had never dealt with Ace but knew of Ace as Bolt's sales agent through business contacts, and taking a cash deposit was usual for an agent in Ace's position, so Young reasonably believed Ace was still authorized. Because Young received no notice (and Bolt gave no general public notice, such as publication, to reach persons like Young), Ace's apparent authority was not terminated as to Young, and Bolt is bound by the contract.

The lack of implied or express authority does not defeat Young's claim, because apparent authority binds the principal even when actual authority (express or implied) has ended. A principal is not an insurer of an agent's acts; Bolt is liable here only because of the lingering apparent authority it failed to cut off.
questions.explanationJa:
代理関係が終了すると代理人の実際の権限は消滅しますが、代理人に権限があると合理的に信じている第三者に対しては、終了の通知を受けるまで表見代理（apparent authority）が続きます（Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.11）。Bolt は Ace の既知の顧客にしか通知していません。Young は Ace と取引したことはありませんが、取引上のつながりで Ace を Bolt の販売代理人として知っており、手付金の受領もその地位の代理人として普通のことだったので、Ace に権限があると合理的に信じていました。Young は通知を受けておらず、Bolt は公告など Young のような者に届く一般的な通知もしていないため、Young に対する表見代理は消滅しておらず、Bolt は契約に拘束されます。

表見代理は、実際の権限（明示・黙示）が消滅していても本人を拘束するので、黙示の権限や明示の権限が無いことは Young の請求を妨げません。また本人は代理人の行為の保険者ではなく、本問で Bolt が責任を負うのは、表見代理を断ち切らなかったからです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.26

questions.stem: Young Corp. hired Wilson as a sales representative for six months at a salary of $5,000 per month plus 6% of sales. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Young does not have the power to dismiss Wilson during the six-month period without cause.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Wilson is obligated to act solely in Young's interest in matters concerning Young's business.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The agreement between Young and Wilson is not enforceable unless it is in writing and signed by Wilson.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The agreement between Young and Wilson formed an agency coupled with an interest.

questions.explanation:
As Young's sales representative, Wilson is an agent and owes Young a fiduciary duty of loyalty. Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.01, an agent has a duty to act loyally for the principal's benefit in all matters connected with the agency relationship, so Wilson must act solely in Young's interest in matters concerning Young's business.

Young does have the power to dismiss Wilson at any time, even without cause; a principal always has the power (though not necessarily the right) to revoke an agent's authority, and a dismissal in breach of the six-month term only makes Young liable for damages (§3.10). The agreement need not be in writing, because a six-month contract can be performed within one year and is outside the Statute of Frauds. Wilson's salary and commission are compensation for services, not an interest in the subject matter of the agency, so no agency coupled with an interest was formed.
questions.explanationJa:
Wilson は Young の販売代理人として代理人に当たり、Young に対して信認義務の一つである忠実義務を負います。Restatement (Third) of Agency §8.01 により、代理人は代理関係に関わるすべての事項で本人の利益のために忠実に行動する義務があるので、Wilson は Young の事業に関する事項で Young の利益のためだけに行動しなければなりません。

Young は理由がなくてもいつでも Wilson を解任する権能を持ちます。本人は代理人の権限を撤回する権能（権利とは限らない）を常に持ち、6か月の契約期間に反する解任は損害賠償責任を生じるにとどまります（§3.10）。6か月の契約は1年以内に履行可能なので詐欺防止法（Statute of Frauds）の対象外で、書面は不要です。給与と歩合は役務の対価であって代理の対象物に対する権利ではないため、利益付き代理（agency coupled with an interest）にもなりません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.27

questions.stem: Easy Corp. is a real estate developer and regularly engages real estate brokers to act on its behalf in acquiring parcels of land. The brokers are authorized to enter into such contracts, but are instructed to do so in their own names without disclosing Easy's identity or relationship to the transaction. If a broker enters into a contract with a seller on Easy's behalf,

choices.label: A
choices.text: The broker will have the same actual authority as if Easy's identity had been disclosed.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Easy will be bound by the contract because of the broker's apparent authority

choices.label: C
choices.text: Easy will not be liable for any negligent acts committed by the broker while acting on Easy's behalf.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The broker will not be personally bound by the contract because the broker has express authority to act.

questions.explanation:
Actual authority depends on the principal's manifestations to the agent, not on what the third party knows (Restatement (Third) of Agency §2.01). Easy expressly authorized the brokers to enter into land purchase contracts, so a broker has the same actual authority whether or not Easy's identity is disclosed; Easy's instruction to act in the broker's own name only makes Easy an undisclosed principal.

Easy is bound because of the broker's actual (express) authority, not apparent authority. Apparent authority requires a manifestation by the principal to the third party (§2.03, §3.03), and an undisclosed principal makes no manifestation to the seller. Easy is not free of all liability for the broker's negligent acts; whether Easy is liable depends on the relationship and the scope of the work, and a statement that Easy will not be liable for any such acts is too broad. The broker is personally bound, because an agent who contracts for an undisclosed principal is a party to the contract even when acting with express authority (§6.03).
questions.explanationJa:
実際の権限は、第三者が何を知っているかではなく、本人から代理人への表示によって決まります（Restatement (Third) of Agency §2.01）。Easy はブローカーに土地購入契約を締結する権限を明示的に与えているので、Easy の名前が明かされるかどうかにかかわらず、ブローカーの実際の権限は同じです。自分の名前で契約せよという指示は、Easy を隠れた本人にするだけです。

Easy が拘束されるのは、ブローカーの実際の（明示の）権限によるもので、表見代理によるものではありません。表見代理には本人から第三者への表示が必要で（§2.03、§3.03）、隠れた本人は売主に何も表示していません。ブローカーの過失行為について Easy が一切責任を負わないとも言えません（関係や職務の範囲によって責任が生じ得るので、「一切負わない」は言い過ぎです）。また隠れた本人のために契約した代理人は、明示の権限があっても契約当事者として個人的に拘束されます（§6.03）。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.29

questions.stem: Generally, an agency relationship is terminated by operation of law in all the following situations except the

choices.label: A
choices.text: Principal's death

choices.label: B
choices.text: Principal's incapacity

choices.label: C
choices.text: Agent's renunciation of the agency

choices.label: D
choices.text: Agent's failure to acquire a necessary business license

questions.explanation:
An agent's renunciation of the agency terminates the relationship by an act of a party, not by operation of law. Under Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.10, an agent's actual authority terminates when the agent renounces it (or the principal revokes it), by the parties' own manifestation.

The other events terminate the agency by operation of law. The principal's death terminates actual authority (§3.07(2)), and the principal's loss of capacity terminates it as well (§3.08). An agent's failure to obtain a business license required by law to perform the agency makes performance illegal, and supervening illegality or loss of a required qualification terminates the agency by operation of law.
questions.explanationJa:
代理人による辞任（renunciation）は当事者の意思表示による終了であり、法の作用による終了ではありません。Restatement (Third) of Agency §3.10 により、代理人が辞任した場合（または本人が撤回した場合）、当事者自身の表示によって実際の権限が消滅します。

ほかの事由は法の作用による終了です。本人の死亡（§3.07(2)）や本人の行為能力の喪失（§3.08）で実際の権限は消滅します。代理業務に法律上必要な事業免許を代理人が取得できない場合は、業務の遂行が違法になるため、違法・必要資格の喪失として法の作用により代理関係が終了します。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Fiduciary Relationships Q.30
